get.description: Exact-match filters and descending timestamp/UUID keyset pagination; DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE and MAX_PAGE_SIZE bound each page.

post.description: HMAC-SHA256 signs timestamp + '.' + canonical event UUID + '.' + the exact body bytes. The signature is sha256= followed by lowercase hex. Timestamp skew, replay reservations, body size and field lengths use the configured WEBHOOK_* bounds. A supplied session cookie is also subject to session and CSRF checks.

schema.description: The validated alert envelope; raw data remains data, never markup.
schema.title: WebhookAlert

post.description: Link or create an incident, append evidence and activity, and return mock enrichment. An absent indicator yields null intelligence; existing links may be reinvestigated.
No session is required. If a live session cookie is sent, double-submit CSRF is required.

get.description: Descending timestamp/UUID keyset pagination, bounded by DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE and MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

post.description: Title and description use INCIDENT_MAX_TEXT_CHARS; distinct alert IDs use INCIDENT_MAX_ALERTS. All active legacy roles share the same tenant.

get.description: Evidence is scoped to the supplied incident, with descending timestamp/UUID keyset pagination bounded by DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE and MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

post.description: Only deterministic mock results are available; THREAT_INTEL_BULK_MAX_ITEMS bounds input.
